turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
A fair bit, honestly. I'm out on the streets a lot with my camera — street photography is the thing I keep coming back to[[street-photo]], and I collect photography books along the way. I cook, I'm always listening to music, I used to DJ, and I love to travel — I'm drawn to places with a bit of a reputation.

I live in Bordeaux[[bordeaux]] these days too, so there's family life woven through all of it.

I collect photography books, cook a fair bit, and I've always got music on while I do any of it — I used to DJ, so that habit runs deep.
